questions.q: Who typically serves as the Executive Sponsor on an Oracle Fusion Financials implementation?
options: A senior client leader, often the CFO
questions.explain: The Executive Sponsor is a senior client leader, often the CFO on a Financials project, who owns the business case and resolves escalations.

questions.q: Which role leads requirements gathering, fit-gap, configuration, and testing for one specific module such as Cash Management?
questions.explain: The Functional Consultant leads a specific module end to end: requirements, fit-gap, configuration, and test scripts.

questions.q: Which role is responsible for the overall cross-module solution shape so that individual module designs don't conflict?
questions.explain: The Solution Architect owns the overall technical and functional solution across modules.

questions.q: Which role manages communication and training readiness as part of the human side of adopting a new system?
questions.explain: The OCM Lead manages change management activities like communication and training readiness, distinct from technical implementation work.

questions.q: In the Brightfield Industrial Group example, who are the Business Process Owners?
options: Brightfield's own AP, AR, and GL managers
questions.explain: Brightfield pairs its own CFO and AP/AR/GL managers (Business Process Owners) with the implementation partner's consultant team.
